definition: [ מָעַד ] verb slip, slide, totter, shake (only Hebrew); — Qal Perfect 3 plural מָֽעֲדוּ 2Sam 22:37 = Ps 18:37 Imperfect 3 feminine singular תִּמְעַד Ps 37:31 אֶמְעָ֑ד Ps 26:1 Participle plural construct מוֺעֲדֵי Job 12:5 — slip , subject feet, (figurative) 2Sam 22:37 = Ps 18:37 ; Job 12:5 subject אֲשֻׁרָיו Ps 37:31 compare Ps 26:1 . Pu`al Participle מוּעָ֑דֶת ( = ׳ מְמוּ Ges «GKC:53s»§ 53s ; or old Qal Passive participle , — compare Ba NB 273 ; — but passive not needed here, read perhaps ׳ מוֺ Qal Participle active see Schw ZAW x, 1890, 176 ); — ׳ רֶגֶל מ Prov 25:19 (simile of untrustworthiness). Hiph`il Perfect וְהִמְעַדְתָּ֫ (so read for HCT והעמדת , compare Sm Co Da Berthol ) Ezek 29:7 cause to shake object כָּלמָֿתְנַיִם , i.e. make them totter ; compare Imperative הַמְעַ֑ד (object id. ) Ps 69:24 .
